page.notes: Greek readings are doubtful throughout: the scan is faint and small, so most Greek words carry [?] and their accents and endings should be checked against the original. German glosses are set in black letter and are marked with bl. The entry for "Ameis" is partly garbled on the scan; the Latin and German glosses are read as printed. The last line runs to the foot of the page, so the paragraph continues on the next page; I left it open. The heading is an italic line, read as a level 2 part title.
